description: Unit tests for Curve25519 key exchange implementation in the quiche QUIC library, testing both synchronous and asynchronous key exchange methods.

classes.name: Curve25519KeyExchangeTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing Curve25519 key exchange functionality.

classes.name: TestCallbackResult
classes.description: Holds the result of an asynchronous key exchange callback, indicating success or failure.

classes.name: TestCallback
classes.description: Callback class for asynchronous key exchange, sets the result in TestCallbackResult.

methods.name: set_ok
methods.description: Sets the success status of the callback result.

methods.name: ok
methods.description: Returns whether the callback result indicates success.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the callback, setting the result status.
